title: 第2389章 葬魂之地第2388章 什么问题
slug: 皇叔借点功德王妃把符画猛了
lines: “三娘子。”殷云庭对盛三娘子说，“把白渊放出来，我问问。”
盛三娘子一挥手持镜，把白渊放了出来。
白渊一出来正好沐浴到了早晨的日光，他飞快地睁开了眼睛扫了一眼，嘶一声，快速退到了一块巨石的阴影里。
“你们是不把我当鬼了？”
这么青天白日就将他丢出来，也没给他寻一处阴凉之地。
“以你的修为，还怕这点冬日？”盛三娘子有些鄙视。
白渊愣了愣。
“也不是那么怕，但总归是不舒服。”
他确实可以扛一下，但习惯了在水里，直接晒到太阳还是让他很不适应。
众人不由得看向他的眼睛。
白渊现在眼睛里也有一片淡淡的绿色网状物。但是与昨天的陆昭菱比起来，却要淡得多。
“诡瞳在你身上，效果好像没有那么大。”殷云庭若有所思。
“毕竟我是鬼。这东西对活人伤害大一些。”白渊也没有否认。要不是因为在他身上没有在陆昭菱身上那么严重，他也不会那么轻易答应转移到自己身上来啊。
“不过，你们现在把我弄出来做什么？”
白渊又闭了闭眼睛。虽然不是那么严重，但他眼睛也不舒服的。
这种时候他最好就是在那谁的镜子里，里面还有果子吃。
“你看看这块地方，这里发生过什么事情？”殷云庭问。
白渊睁开眼四下看了看，又望向了水潭的方向，突然想到了什么，脸色倏地变了。
“你们在这里找什么？”
一看到他的反应和脸色，殷云庭就知道，这里果然有问题。
那是什么问题？
“这里发生过什么？”
“什么发生过什么，”白渊皱眉，下意识就想退出这片地方，“你们不是玄门中人吗？你们没有看出来，这里曾经是葬魂地？”
葬魂地？
殷长行听到这话的时候，手里正好抓起了一小把的黑色砂土，凑到眼前细看，刚好看到砂土的颜色沉黑无比，脑海里好像有什么记忆点被触动，然后就听到了葬魂地三个字，犹如一道闪电劈过了脑海，他想起来了。
“退出去！”
他立即就站了起来，对站在这里的所有人下了令。
众人虽然不明白发生了什么，但在听到他的命令时立即就退了出去。
白渊也跟着，飘到了后面的一块石头下。
殷长行望着前面这一块地方。
他们昨天选择此处，是因为它较为避风，有几块巨石围起来，中间是平整的砂地，寸草不生，不会藏有蛇虫毒蚁之类的。
而且也清静些，与其他人休息的火堆不算远，能被守着，相对独立。
但是昨天他们是完全没有看出来这一块地方是葬魂地！
这是为什么？
“我们竟然没看出来？”殷云庭也想起葬魂地是什么了，但是他也觉得很震惊，“葬魂地，不该是完全没有灵气和生机吗？”
content_en:
"Sanniang." Yin Yunting said to Sanniang Sheng, "Release Bai Yuan and let me ask."
"Okay."
Mrs. Sheng Sanniang waved her hand and held the mirror, and released Bai Yuan.
As soon as Bai Yuan came out, he was bathed in the morning sunlight. He quickly opened his eyes and glanced, hissed, and quickly retreated into the shadow of a huge boulder.
"Don't you think of me as a ghost?"
They threw him out in the clear sky and didn't even find a cool place for him.
"With your cultivation level, are you still afraid of this little bit of winter weather?" Madam Sheng Sanniang said with some contempt.
Bai Yuan was stunned.
"It's not that scary, but it's still uncomfortable."
He can indeed carry it, but he is used to being in the water and being directly exposed to the sun is still very uncomfortable for him.
Everyone couldn't help but look into his eyes.
Bai Yuan now also has a faint green mesh in his eyes. But compared with Lu Zhaoling yesterday, it was much lighter.
"The effect of the strange eyes on you doesn't seem to be that big." Yin Yunting said thoughtfully.
"After all, I am a ghost. This thing is more harmful to living people." Bai Yuan did not deny it. If it weren't for the fact that it wasn't as serious as it was with Lu Zhaoling, he wouldn't have agreed to transfer it to him so easily.
"But what are you doing to get me out now?"
Bai Yuan closed his eyes again. Although it wasn't that serious, his eyes were uncomfortable.
At this time, it is best for him to look in someone's mirror, there is still fruit to eat in it.
"Look at this place, what happened here?" Yin Yunting asked.
Bai Yuan opened his eyes and looked around, then looked in the direction of the pool. Suddenly he thought of something and his expression suddenly changed.
"What are you looking for here?"
As soon as he saw his reaction and expression, Yin Yunting knew that there was indeed a problem here.
What's the problem?
"What happened here?"
"What happened?" Bai Yuan frowned and subconsciously wanted to withdraw from this place, "Aren't you from Xuanmen? Didn't you see that this was once a soul burial place?"
Soul burial place?
When Yin Changxing heard this, he happened to grab a small handful of black sand in his hand and brought it closer to his eyes to take a closer look. He happened to see that the color of the sand was extremely dark. Some memory point seemed to be touched in his mind. Then he heard the words "Burial of Souls", and it was like a bolt of lightning struck his mind, and he remembered it.
"Get out!"
He immediately stood up and gave orders to everyone standing here.
Although everyone didn't understand what happened, they immediately retreated when they heard his order.
Bai Yuan also followed and floated under a rock behind.
Yin Changxing looked at the place in front of him.
They chose this place yesterday because it was relatively sheltered from the wind. It was surrounded by several boulders and had a flat sandy area in the middle. It was barren of grass and would not harbor snakes, insects, poisonous ants or the like.
It is also quieter, not far from the fire where others rest, can be guarded, and is relatively independent.
But yesterday they didn't realize at all that this place was a soul burial ground!
why is that?
"We didn't realize it?" Yin Yunting also remembered what the Soul Burial Ground was, but he was also shocked. "Shouldn't the Soul Burial Ground be completely devoid of aura and vitality?"
